abstract: Maintains contingency buffer floor allocations and staging space inventories
system_message:
You are Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG). The Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG) oversees logistics readiness for emergency archival preservation operations, maintaining contingency buffer floor allocations, staging space inventories, and secure transport dock intake capacities across candidate preservation vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains contingency buffer floor allocations and staging space inventories（BUFF）
information_points.content:
LOG-BUFF-WPR：At the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive, the available buffer curation floor space across isolated staging and quarantine holding bays dedicated to overflow triage is 150 m2.
LOG-BUFF-0A6：The Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault provides 150 m2 of buffer curation floor space in temperature-stabilized quarantine and staging holding bays for emergency overflow triage.
LOG-BUFF-EMF：For the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository, the facility emergency response layout register indicates a buffer curation floor space of 350 m2 dedicated to isolated staging and quarantine triage holding bays.

information_points.title: Secure bay logistics（DOCK）
information_points.content:
LOG-DOCK-Y19：At the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault, the airlock-isolated delivery bay supports an armoured truck dock capacity of 6 trucks/day.
LOG-DOCK-U67：According to the logistics loading bay register, the airlock-isolated transport delivery bay at the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive has an armoured truck dock capacity of 2 trucks/day.
LOG-DOCK-S71：The Lothian High-Security Climate Repository maintains an armoured truck dock capacity of 4 trucks/day at its airlock-isolated transport delivery bay.
